raw_text: U.S. Central Command is aware of the seizure of the motor vehicle carrier Galaxy Leader by Houthi forces in the southern Red Sea. The vessel was transiting international waters when it was illegally boarded. The United States condemns this act of piracy and calls for the immediate release of the vessel and its crew. CENTCOM is closely coordinating with regional and international partners to ensure the safety of maritime navigation in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden.
